Cc: security@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 6 Apr 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Preservation request — April 3 service disruption: log slices & forensic handoff

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick status update after our outage on April 3. Our security team needs a short-term preservation hold so we can complete our internal forensics. Can you confirm the following items and timelines: 

- Preserve all request/response logs and KV cache snapshots for the window 2028-04-03T02:00:00Z to 2028-04-03T06:00:00Z.
- Export a hash-verified slice of the relevant logs (including request_ids) and provide a chain-of-custody manifest.
- Provide evidence of retention policy override and expected earliest deletion date if preservation isn’t extended.
- We may request a secure transfer of a subset of logs to our secure S3 bucket for deeper analysis. Please confirm: transfer method, expected availability, and who will sign the transfer manifest.

We need the items above available by 2028-04-08. If there are any legal constraints or PII redaction steps you require, let us know.

Jordan Lee
Sr. Security Ops, AcmeCorp
security@acmecorp.com

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. We can meet your timeline; below is our intended plan and a couple of clarifying questions.

Planned deliverables (target: 2028-04-08 EOD PT):
- Preserved hold on full raw request/response logs and KV cache artifacts for the window you specified.
- Hash-verified log slice in NDJSON format + chain-of-custody manifest (PDF).
- Secure transfer prepared as a presigned S3 upload link (temporary, expiring) or via our SecureShare endpoint — whichever your team prefers.
- Signed transfer manifest (I will coordinate signatures).

Clarifications we need from you:
1) Confirm whether Acme will accept a presigned PUT link (we will push the files from our side) or if you require us to push into your bucket using your provided S3 creds.
2) Any required redaction rules? We can provide both raw and a redacted variant; redaction will add time to delivery.

Internal owners: Soojin — will handle the log extraction and hash verification. Jonas — handle KV cache snapshot extraction and packaging. Vanessa — prepare the transfer manifest and coordinate signatures with Legal (Laura).

I’m copying Legal (Laura) to confirm chain-of-custody language.

—
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Team — forwarding Jordan’s request. High priority: Acme needs preserved slices + chain-of-custody by 2028-04-08. Please see assigned tasks below and reply with ETA.

Tasks:
- Soojin: extract request/response logs for 2028-04-03T02:00:00Z -> 2028-04-03T06:00:00Z; produce NDJSON slice, compute SHA256 per file, and include a checksums manifest. Label filenames with request_id ranges.
- Jonas: snapshot KV caches (model session cache) relevant to the same window; include metadata (model id, runtime, quantization profile). Put snapshot in immutable storage and record URI.
- Vanessa: draft the transfer manifest (use chain_of_custody_template.docx), include sign-off lines for Marissa and Acme security. Add a short log of who handled the files and timestamps.

Attachments (for internal packaging): forensic_manifest.xlsx; chain_of_custody_template.docx; forensic_evidence_checklist.pdf

Please include the S3 transfer instructions from infra when you have them and update the shared Ticket #INC-2147.

Thanks — Marissa

- Storage: placing artifacts into the "forensics/holds/ACME/2028-04-03" immutable bucket with object lock enabled.
